# cursor-hindsight-ondemand

> On-demand local Hindsight memory daemon for Cursor on Windows.

This project starts `hindsight-embed` only when a Cursor agent session or MCP tools need memory — not at Windows logon. Traffic stays on `http://127.0.0.1:9077` so a cold start does not fall through to Hindsight Cloud.

Pairs with [cursor-model-orchestrator](https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-model-orchestrator) **stack** profile (soft Hindsight retain via MCP server name `hindsight`); this repo is lifecycle only, not the model router.

## Not included

GitNexus, model-routing YAML, and the `model-orchestrator` skill are out of scope. This repo only covers on-demand Hindsight lifecycle wrappers for Cursor.
